selection_rule: Highest train assessment macro-F1, then accuracy, then earliest prompt in this protocol. Freeze winner before dev evaluation.

runtime_identity.world_prefix: Unordered reports about one snapshot. No report has priority. Missing information is unknown.

label_descriptions.supported: Only the positive assertion is explicitly reported.
label_descriptions.refuted: Only the negative assertion is explicitly reported.
label_descriptions.both: Both assertions are explicitly reported, so reports conflict.
label_descriptions.unknown: Neither assertion is explicitly reported; information is missing.

task_templates.name: decision_0
task_templates.instruction: What do the reports say about this claim: "{positive}"? Check only the exact named entity.

labels.affirmed: The claim is stated and is not denied.
labels.denied: The claim is denied and is not stated.
labels.conflicting: The claim is both stated and denied in different reports.
labels.not_mentioned: The reports neither state nor deny the claim.
